About The Company

The Delhi Cloth & General Mills Company Limited (DCM) was originally founded in 1889. Since then, the story of DCM has been one of sustainable growth and reinvention. The DCM story has closely paralleled that of India, with each landmark in DCM’s historybeing mirrored in the industrial progress of the country.

 

Daurala Sugar Works first commenced operations in 1932, in the pre-independence era as one of the largest and most modern sugar manufacturing units in the country. The Daurala Distillery was established shortly after this, in 1943.

​

A century after DCM was founded, on 1 st April, 1990, DCM Shriram Industries Limited (NSE/BSE: DCMSRIND/523369) became the flagship company that inherited the legacy of the DCM Group.

Our Process
The manufacturing of sugar is a systematic industrial process that begins with the extraction of juice from shredded sugarcane stalks using high-pressure rollers. This raw juice undergoes clarification, where lime and heat are applied to neutralize acidity and remove impurities through sedimentation. The purified liquid is then concentrated into a thick syrup via multiple-effect evaporation under a vacuum to prevent scorching.

During crystallization, the syrup is seeded with tiny sugar grains to encourage crystal growth, creating a dense mixture called massecuite. Finally, a centrifuge spins the massecuite at high speeds to separate the solid sugar crystals from the liquid molasses, followed by a drying and grading phase to produce the final granulated product.

OUR PROCESS

Extraction

Sugar is sourced from extensive sugarcane-growing regions a sprawling complex located at Daurala, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. DCM Shriram operates sugar manufacturing facilities in key sugarcane-rich belts, where freshly harvested cane is efficiently crushed to extract juice and refined through advanced processes into high-quality sugar crystals that meet stringent quality standards.

Clarification & Purification

Daurala Sugar Works was established in the pre independence era in the year 1932 at Daurala, a small unknown village near Meerut on New Delhi - Haridwar National highway no. 58. Today, after more than eight decades it continues to command respect as one of the more efficient and modern sugar factories of the country, being a familiar name not only in India but overseas as well.

Social Responsibility

Communities have always been at the centre of the DCM Group’s approach to business. Long before CSR became a statutory requirement, the DCM Group believed in giving back to society as an essential part of its purpose.


This vision led to the establishment of several institutions of excellence, including cultural centres, schools, and colleges. These continue to thrive today, serving as landmarks of progress and learning – including Daurala’s Community Hospital and Dispensary, the Sir Shri Ram Inter College in Daurala, and the Shankar Lall Murli Dhar Memorial Society promoting arts and culture across India.

DCM Shriram Maintains Strong Quality and Safety Standards Across Facilities

Why Choose DCMSR

At DCM Shriram, we produce high-quality sugar using reliable processes, follow strict quality standards, ensure timely exports, and work responsibly to supply trusted sugar products to customers across global markets.
Quality Systems
Highest degree of product specifications and quality standards are maintained by adopting world-class quality systems. ISO 9000 series certification has been received from RWTUV of Germany and Det Norsk Veritas of Norway.
Research & Development
Research & Development is a continuous process. Focus is on maintaining a technological edge through product development, technology upgradation, energy conservation, pollution control, optimisation of resources, and conservation of environment.
Environment
Manufacturing units of the Company are like garden factories. Utmost attention is paid to treatment of effluents, control of pollution, and conservation of environment. This constitutes a specific target of R&D effort. 
Exceptional Customer Service
Exceptional Customer Service
Our experienced team provides prompt support, clear communication, and customized solutions to meet your needs. We focus on building strong relationships and ensuring a smooth and satisfying experience for every customer.
Sustainability
Responsible sugar manufacturing always begins with the sugarcane farmer. At DCMSR, we focus on ethical sourcing, ecosystem management, and community support. Our manufacturing facilities embody the values of environmental stewardship, and we have consistently led the industry in sustainable innovations like green power co-generation, bio-composting, integrated effluent treatment, and water conservation.
See More

Where Sustainability Meets Structure.

Empowering Farmers
Daurala partners with 50,000 farmers and their families to cultivate and procure sugarcane in a sustainable manner. 
A pioneer of sugarcane development in India, Dauralahas always led the industry with cane development activities such as key varietal propagation, soil testing, continuous farmer education drives, and environmentally conscious input management.
